projects.title: Stay The Night?
projects.description: First-person indie horror game. The player has to survive an unexpected night after a first date, using whatever they can find without getting caught.

projects.title: Room For One
projects.description: Multiplayer platforming racer: race friends to the last available hotel room. Programmed the networking, UI, and art direction.

projects.title: Golf Bash: Online
projects.description: A multiplayer golf party game built around physics-based chaos. Built with Netcode for GameObjects.

projects.title: The Greatest Film of All Time
projects.description: A game adaptation inspired by Grave of the Fireflies. You play as Seita, navigating a war-torn landscape while keeping his sister alive.

projects.title: Aura Game
projects.description: A hand-drawn rhythm game built to capture the vibe of Rhythm Heaven. Keep the beat and don't let him trip.

projects.title: Lethal Love
projects.description: A dating sim with a thriller edge. The environment reveals more about itself the further you get into the story.

projects.title: Sketchpad
projects.description: A TypeScript + HTML5 Canvas drawing app with adjustable brush tools, sticker placement, and undo/redo, built to demonstrate clean state management.

projects.title: Tidal Residual Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed real tidal datasets to evaluate the accuracy of predicted tide models by computing residuals between observed and expected values.

projects.title: Astronomical Data Analysis
projects.description: Processed astronomical image data to detect and evaluate objects captured in telescopic imagery.

projects.title: Creative Coding
projects.description: A series of interactive creative coding experiments built with JavaScript and p5.js: procedural generation, visual systems, and real-time rendering in the browser.

projects.title: HeatSync
projects.description: A wave-based survival combat game: fight off a horde of snowmen while managing your own heat level.
